_about: Hand-authored thin-slice fact sheets for retrieval, structured facets, and KG edge coverage.

commodities.description: Footwear with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics, with upper straps or thongs assembled to the sole by means of plugs
commodities.self_text: Flip-flops, thongs, beach sandals, jandals, jelly shoes. Rubber or plastic uppers assembled to the sole by plugs or pegs. No closure mechanism. Open-toe, open-heel. Casual or beach use. Common in summer ranges.

commodities.description: Other footwear with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics, with upper of straps but not assembled by plugs, with insole length under 24cm
commodities.self_text: Plastic strappy sandals for children. Rubber or plastic outers but uppers are stitched or moulded, not plugged. Open or closed toe possible. Smaller sizes.

commodities.description: Footwear with outer soles of rubber or plastics, with uppers of leather, not covering the ankle, men's
commodities.self_text: Men's casual leather shoes with rubber soles. Loafers, slip-ons, low-cut leather shoes. Leather upper, synthetic outer sole. Ankle not covered. Adult sizes.

commodities.description: Sports footwear; tennis shoes, basketball shoes, gym shoes, training shoes and the like, with outer soles of rubber or plastics and uppers of textile materials
commodities.self_text: Sneakers, trainers, running shoes, tennis shoes, gym shoes, basketball shoes. Canvas or synthetic mesh upper. Rubber sole. Made for athletic activity or athleisure wear.

commodities.description: Slippers and other indoor footwear with outer soles of rubber/plastics and uppers of textile materials
commodities.self_text: House slippers, indoor slippers, mules. Soft textile upper, soft sole. Designed for indoor wear, not the street.

commodities.description: Footwear with outer soles and uppers of leather, covering the ankle, with main sole and heel combined exceeding 3cm
commodities.self_text: Leather boots. Leather sole, leather upper, ankle covered. Chunky sole/heel construction. Hiking-style boots, work boots, fashion ankle boots.

commodities.description: Wine of fresh grapes, in containers holding 2 litres or less, of an actual alcoholic strength by volume not exceeding 15%
commodities.self_text: Still wine in standard bottles or smaller. Red, white, rose. 750ml typical. Up to 15% ABV. Includes most table wines. Excludes sparkling and fortified wines.

commodities.description: Sparkling wine of fresh grapes, with an actual alcoholic strength by volume of not less than 8.5% but less than 13%
commodities.self_text: Sparkling wine. Champagne, Prosecco, Cava, English sparkling. Pressurised CO2. 8.5%-12.5% ABV typical. Cork or crown closure.

commodities.description: Single malt whisky, in containers holding 2 litres or less
commodities.self_text: Scotch whisky, Irish whiskey, single malt, bourbon, rye. Spirit distilled from grain. 40-46% ABV typical. Bottle 700ml or smaller.

commodities.description: Beer made from malt, in containers holding 10 litres or less, of an alcoholic strength by volume exceeding 0.5% but not exceeding 5.5%
commodities.self_text: Beer, lager, ale, stout, pilsner. Made from malted barley with hops. Bottle, can, or small keg. 0.5%-5.5% ABV (standard strength).

commodities.description: Waters, including mineral waters and aerated waters, containing added sugar or other sweetening matter or flavoured
commodities.self_text: Soft drinks, flavoured water, cola, lemonade, energy drinks (non-alcoholic). Sugar may attract Soft Drinks Industry Levy (SDIL). No alcohol.

commodities.description: Sinks and wash basins, of stainless steel
commodities.self_text: Stainless steel kitchen or utility sinks. Top-mounted, under-mounted, or wall-mounted. Single or double bowl. Brushed or polished finish. For domestic or commercial use.

commodities.description: Table, kitchen or other household articles of stainless steel
commodities.self_text: Stainless steel kitchenware. Pots, pans, mixing bowls, kitchen utensils, household ware. Excludes cutlery (Ch 82) and sinks (7324).

commodities.description: Cooking appliances and plate warmers for gas fuel or for both gas and other fuels, of iron or steel, for domestic use
commodities.self_text: Gas hobs, gas cookers, gas ovens for the home. Steel body. Includes range cookers and freestanding gas cookers.
